results.question: 一共有多少客户
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers AS c WHERE c.is_test = 0 LIMIT 200

results.question: 有效订单有多少笔
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS order_count FROM orders AS o JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped', 'done') AND c.is_test = 0 LIMIT 200

results.question: 2026 年 6 月的 GMV 是多少
results.sql: SELECT SUM(o.pay_amount) AS gmv FROM orders AS o JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped', 'done') AND c.is_test = 0 AND o.created_at >= '2026-06-01' AND o.created_at < '2026-07-01' LIMIT 200

results.question: 华东区 2026 年第二季度的 GMV 是多少
results.sql: SELECT SUM(o.pay_amount) AS gmv FROM orders AS o JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped', 'done') AND c.is_test = 0 AND c.region = '华东' AND o.created_at >= '2026-04-01' AND o.created_at < '2026-07-01' LIMIT 200

results.question: 各大区的 GMV 排名
results.sql: SELECT c.region, SUM(o.pay_amount) AS gmv FROM orders AS o JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped', 'done') AND c.is_test = 0 GROUP BY c.region ORDER BY gmv DESC LIMIT 200

results.question: GMV 最高的 3 个品类是什么
results.sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS gmv FROM order_items AS oi JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.id WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped', 'done') AND c.is_test = 0 GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY gmv DESC LIMIT 3

results.question: 按客单价排序，前 5 个城市是哪些
results.sql: SELECT c.city, SUM(o.pay_amount) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.id), 0) AS aov FROM customers AS c JOIN orders AS o ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped', 'done') AND c.is_test = 0 GROUP BY c.city ORDER BY aov DESC LIMIT 5

results.question: 2026 年 8 月的订单数是多少
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS order_count FROM orders AS o JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped', 'done') AND c.is_test = 0 AND o.created_at >= '2026-08-01' AND o.created_at < '2026-09-01' LIMIT 200

results.question: 2026 年退款总金额是多少
results.sql: SELECT SUM(r.amount) AS refund_amount FROM refunds AS r WHERE r.created_at >= '2026-01-01' AND r.created_at < '2027-01-01' LIMIT 200

results.question: 2026 年上半年的 GMV 是多少
results.sql: SELECT SUM(o.pay_amount) AS gmv FROM orders AS o JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped', 'done') AND c.is_test = 0 AND o.created_at >= '2026-01-01' AND o.created_at < '2026-07-01' LIMIT 200

results.question: 现在在售的商品有多少个
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM products AS p WHERE p.is_active = 1 LIMIT 200

results.question: 手机类商品的平均价格是多少
results.sql: SELECT AVG(p.price) AS avg_price FROM products AS p WHERE p.category = '手机' LIMIT 200

results.question: 2026 年每个月的 GMV 分别是多少
results.sql: SELECT STRFTIME('%Y-%m', o.created_at) AS year_month, SUM(o.pay_amount) AS gmv FROM orders AS o JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped', 'done') AND c.is_test = 0 AND o.created_at >= '2026-01-01' AND o.created_at < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY STRFTIME('%Y-%m', o.created_at) ORDER BY year_month LIMIT 200

results.question: 下单次数最多的客户下了多少单
results.sql: SELECT MAX(customer_order_count) AS order_count FROM (SELECT COUNT(o.id) AS customer_order_count FROM orders AS o JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped', 'done') AND c.is_test = 0 GROUP BY o.customer_id) LIMIT 200

results.question: 平均每笔订单包含几件商品
results.reason: 结果不同：1 行 vs 标准 1 行
results.sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id), 0) AS avg_items_per_order FROM order_items AS oi JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped', 'done') AND c.is_test = 0 LIMIT 200

results.question: 2026 年新增了多少客户

results.question: 除了已取消和已退款，还有多少订单
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS order_count FROM orders AS o JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE NOT o.status IN ('cancelled', 'refunded') AND c.is_test = 0 LIMIT 200
